verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform with AI-assisted audience building, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents connecting or plugging in external MCP servers or using their tools. The integrations, APIs and OpenAPI spec cover data forwarding and ingestion, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
